## 行程

### 上午: 錦糸町 -> 川越
* [川越駅](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Kawagoe+Station/@35.9071163,139.4802556,17z/data=!4m7!3m6!1s0x6018da56ca35ba65:0xc21a3e31f66eccce!8m2!3d35.9071163!4d139.4824443!15sCgnlt53otornq5mSARdsb2dpY2FsX3RyYW5zaXRfc3RhdGlvbuABAA!16zL20vMDVtMWxm!18m1!1e1?entry=tts&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxMi4wIPu8ASoASAFQAw%3D%3D&skid=03af1837-5150-4386-8639-4f19866048e4) ([路線](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/Keisei+Richmond+Hotel+Tokyo+Kinshicho,+3+Chome-2-7+Kotobashi,+Sumida+City,+Tokyo+130-0022,+Japan/Kawagoe+Station,+Kawagoe,+Saitama,+Japan/@35.795826,139.6492761,11z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m14!4m13!1m5!1m1!1s0x601888d88d1ab3bd:0x254b91a22fe762a!2m2!1d139.8149441!2d35.6936367!1m5!1m1!1s0x6018da56ca35ba65:0xc21a3e31f66eccce!2m2!1d139.4824443!2d35.9071163!3e3!18m1!1e1?entry=tts&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxMi4wKgBIAVAD&skid=682558cc-e519-4808-b0bd-9021acbdde13), 1 hr 20 min)

### 川越重點景點
* [川越冰川神社](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Kawagoe+Hikawa+Shrine/@35.9275498,139.4885588,17z/data=!3m1!5s0x6018da899118ea65:0x4d1463f3713d26f7!4m6!3m5!1s0x6018da89ead23633:0x7fce7ee6a490f05c!8m2!3d35.9275498!4d139.4885588!16s%2Fg%2F1211cdlp!18m1!1e1?entry=tts&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxMi4wIPu8ASoASAFQAw%3D%3D&skid=1a7224ce-7ab8-490a-af64-40a8cc1b52f2) (8am - 4:30pm): 以結緣鯛魚籤與風鈴廊下（夏季限定）聞名。
* [川越時之鐘](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Toki+no+Kane/@35.9234758,139.483335,17z/data=!4m6!3m5!1s0x6018da6141acb0ad:0xb93b6f615532ff61!8m2!3d35.9234758!4d139.483335!16s%2Fg%2F125_d2mf5!18m1!1e1?entry=tts&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxMi4wIPu8ASoASAFQAw%3D%3D&skid=00e5342b-7d77-4755-8131-586e9a6bd1bd) : 小江戶象徵地標。
* [藏造老街](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Ichibangai+Shotengai/@35.923527,139.4829325,17z/data=!4m6!3m5!1s0x6018da618c4167fb:0x27f2920eda13c433!8m2!3d35.923527!4d139.4829325!16s%2Fg%2F11clvrjpk7!18m1!1e1?entry=tts&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxMi4wIPu8ASoASAFQAw%3D%3D&skid=04cc6918-44f4-48e0-9b64-75804e1b88dd) : 黑磚瓦江戶時代建築群。
* [川越 これがかき氷](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Kore+ga+Kakigori/@35.925285,139.484164,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x6018da61836f7885:0x6c2cc8145e5e7e77!8m2!3d35.925285!4d139.484164!16s%2Fg%2F11g8fkwr6c!18m1!1e1?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxNy4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) (10am - 6:30pm) 日式刨冰
* [菓子屋橫丁](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Kashiya+Yokocho/@35.9250599,139.4788626,17z/data=!4m7!3m6!1s0x6018da640fe3ba7d:0x497dbd8ef274a0fa!8m2!3d35.9250599!4d139.4810513!15sCg_oj5PlrZDlsYvmqavkuIFaFCIS6I-T5a2QIOWxiyDmqasg5LiBkgESdG91cmlzdF9hdHRyYWN0aW9u4AEA!16s%2Fg%2F122r7bvn!18m1!1e1?entry=tts&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxMi4wIPu8ASoASAFQAw%3D%3D&skid=d71762b7-841f-4333-a6c1-bb6c15b72002) (9am - 5pm) : 懷舊古早味糖果小吃街。
* [喜多院](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Kita-in/@35.9176466,139.4818802,15z/data=!4m15!1m8!3m7!1s0x6018daf67650773b:0xeb0ba29520bb6eb5!2sKita-in!8m2!3d35.9175352!4d139.488996!10e2!16s%2Fm%2F03d4fkt!3m5!1s0x6018daf67650773b:0xeb0ba29520bb6eb5!8m2!3d35.9175352!4d139.488996!16s%2Fm%2F03d4fkt?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxNy4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) (9am - 4:30pm)
* 美食: 川越鰻魚飯（小川菊/小川藤）、紫薯霜淇淋、地薯點心。
